main_measure.name: slope t of 72-bar forward excess return on forecast (pooled, sampled bars 0,72,...)
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and timing part > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 500 sampled cases

supporting_check.name: book mean daily return minus gain from the market's own rise (timing part) > 0

decided_by: t >= 2 but the timing part of the book is at or below 0 (or not measurable).
reading: situation = non-zero 72-bar move (raw component value, prices as fallback) on the long side; the coin's mean 72-bar return is the mean of its sampled forward returns over all windows; the position behind each day's market gain is the mean hourly allocation held over that day, and the coin's mean daily return comes from its day-end closes over all windows.
